rationale: I re-derived all five of my round-2 asks against 4c46cf64 and all are addressed. I accept the BRIEF refutation. I independently confirmed the load-bearing new claims on my own scratch bd 1.1.0 plus a probe of the real FindEpicForBead. 'ready --parent E' includes a detached <E>.<N> by prefix, and the title fallback resolves the reporter shape to E. The evaluateMF* aggregation is additive for every Signal consumer. The phase.Cache -n 0 tolerance covers every existing capped caller, so core stays untouched. Two minor asks remain. First, AC-1's G leg is red-on-revert only if the fake bd's --parent semantics are pinned edge-only or G carries a short tag, because real bd 1.1.0 plus today's code selects the plan-titled reporter shape, and the spec should say #255 does not reproduce at e2325e36 for that shape. Second, the per-signal single-Recovery contract needs a rule once MF-3 aggregates mixed-class failures. Neither blocks approval.
concrete_changes_required: AC-1: pin the revert run's fake bd as edge-only for --parent, or add a G' with a short '[NNN]' title tag, so the reporter-shape leg is genuinely red today. In Background A / OQ-9, state that on bd 1.1.0 at e2325e36 the plan-titled reporter shape is selected today (prefix --parent plus full-spec-ID title), so R1.1 hardens against the edge-only and short-tag variants and the real-bd Validation Proof is green today.

R6.2 / R4.4: specify how an aggregated multi-failure signal satisfies spec 124 R1's 'one recovery: line per failing signal' (Signal.Recovery is a single string, consumed by RecoveryCommands → guard.NewFailure). Either emit one recovery per failure record or define a precedence (indeterminate > non-closed > no-candidate > NoEvidence > contradiction > revert) with the rest listed in Detail. Add an AC leg with a two-class MF-3 failure.

findings.title: NEW_ISSUE: AC-1's red-on-revert for bead G depends on the fake bd's --parent semantics, which the AC does not pin; on real bd 1.1.0 today's code SELECTS G
findings.detail: Probed on scratch bd 1.1.0: 'bd ready --parent pq-ei2 -n 0' returns the detached pq-ei2.2 (parent: None) by ID prefix, which confirms the reviser's claim. plan approve titles beads fmt.Sprintf("[%s] %s", specID, heading) (approve/plan.go:682), so containsSpecID keeps G. Today's BuildReadySet therefore selects AC-1's G ('<E>.2, no parent, title [S] …') on a prefix-honouring bd. AC-1's red-on-revert text ('today G is excluded on an edge-only --parent bd, or when its title lacks the full spec ID') is only red if the fixture's fake bd implements --parent by EDGES, or G's title carries a short '[NNN]' tag rather than the full spec ID. AC-1's fixture line says only 'honours -n and the default cap'. Pin one of these: an edge-only --parent fake bd for the revert run, or a second G' with a '[129]' short-tag title (FindEpicForBead still resolves it, but containsSpecID misses it). Otherwise the G leg can pass today. For the same reason, the Validation Proof 'real-bd run of the reporter shape' is green at e2325e36 on bd 1.1.0 with a plan-format title. Background A already words it conditionally ('A bd that reads --parent from edges only, or a title that names [129] but not the full spec ID … drops the reporter's bead'). Say plainly that #255's reported exclusion does not reproduce at e2325e36 on bd 1.1.0 for the plan-title shape (the report was on v0.14.0, pre-128), so R1.1 is hardening against those two variants. It is not a fix of a currently reproducing drop.

findings.title: NEW_ISSUE: R6.2's all-failure aggregation leaves the per-signal recovery contract unspecified
findings.detail: The aggregation itself is feasible without breaking callers. readiness.Signal is consumed only through report.go (AllPass, FailingSignals, RecoveryCommands, Render), by next/ready_gate.go:82/92 and cmd/mindspec/bead_ready.go:57, so adding 'Failures []string' is additive. evaluateMF2 already aggregates its dangling tokens. MF-1, MF-3 and MF-4 return early and need restructuring; findBlockingToken/findBlockingChecklistItem return only the first hit, so MF-4 needs an all-hits variant. The gap: Signal carries ONE Recovery string, and spec 124 R1 / report.go's RecoveryCommands contract is 'one recovery: line per failing signal'. An aggregated MF-3 can mix classes that today carry different recoveries: a non-closed dep → 'mindspec complete <D>'; a NoEvidence dep → 'mindspec reattest <D>'; a no-candidate dep → complete-or-remerge; plus R4.4's per-arm recoveries, and the indeterminate class → 'bd show'. R4.4 says 'each arm ends with its own recovery', which cannot hold inside one Signal.Recovery. Specify the rule: one recovery per failure record (relaxing spec 124 R1's one-per-signal, under ADR-0035), or a priority order with the others listed in Detail. Add an AC leg with a two-class MF-3 failure.

findings.title: Title-fallback lineage is nondeterministic on duplicate spec_num, but in the fail-safe direction
findings.detail: This repo's tracker has epics that share spec_num (closed test fixtures: spec_num 1 ×4; 2, 3, 5 and 6 ×3 each). FindEpicForBeadWithCache's '[NNN]' fallback returns the FIRST epic in AllEpics order with that number. For R1.1 this can only turn a reporter-shaped bead into N2 ('lineage resolves to <E2>'). It can never select another spec's bead, because R1.1 also requires the <E>.<N> ID prefix. No change is required; mention it in OQ-9's limit if the reviser wants the N2 cause to be explainable.

findings.title: New claims verified at 4c46cf64
findings.detail: Verified: bd 1.1.0 'ready --parent E' includes a detached <E>.<N> by ID prefix (own scratch bd). A detached child's 'bd show' has no parent and no dependencies. The global 'bd ready' includes the epic row (issue_type epic, which filterReadyItems drops). Real FindEpicForBead resolves the title-tagged detached child. MergedUnclosed propagates *LandedMergeNoEvidence as an error, and complete.go:739-765 refuses on both the error and !ok arms (attestedRestoreFailure / guard failure); stale_open skips both. So R4.3's 'never a close on unadmitted evidence' holds. TestReattest_ContradictoryBindingOverwrittenAudited and TestReattest_StaleOlderRemergeBindingRewrittenToNewest exist, as do phase.IsLifecycleIssueType and resolve.ResolveTarget. release.go removes the worktree and sets the bead open. The FindLandedMerge caller table is unchanged and complete. bd show dependency entries carry metadata and no parent.
